name: io.github.tonyyang0504/xiaomi_getapps_ads-mcp
description: 小米营销 Xiaomi Ads (ads): me, list_campaigns, update_budget. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOMI_GETAPPS_ADS_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: appId of the external application your Xiaomi account manager (AM) created when Marketing API access was approved ('申请通过后，AM提供appId、appKey等应用信息').

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_XIAOMI_GETAPPS_ADS_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: appKey of that application; exchanged for an access token with POST /foreign/token/createToken.
